title: @ycforge/pilot — ycsf check validation layer contract (spec 020)
description: Machine-readable contract for the ycsf check surface (spec 020): YCK_* error code catalog, exit codes, CheckResult/CheckOptions/YckDiagnostic schemas. Codes are compared via constants in src/check/errors.ts, never string literals (Constitution V). Codes are additive and non-breaking.

checkOptions.title: CheckOptions
checkOptions.description: Options for ycsf check invocation (FR-006, D-6).

validateTf.description: Enable terraform validate final step (C13). Requires terraform init as prerequisite (user responsibility). Default: false.

checkResult.title: CheckResult
checkResult.description: Unified result of all check categories (FR-004). diagnostics is a collect-all array — empty means all checks passed (exit code 0).

diagnostics.description: All diagnostics from all categories — collect-all, never abort-on-first (D-4). Empty array = clean (exit code 0).

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic (union of all families)
diagnostic.description: One validation problem from any check category. Discriminated by 'code' prefix: PML_* (project model), EXT_* (extensions), OUT_* (outputs), MOV_* (moves), YCK_* (check-specific).

code.description: Diagnostic code — PML_*, EXT_*, OUT_*, MOV_*, or YCK_*.

yckDiagnostic.title: YckDiagnostic (check-specific)
yckDiagnostic.description: Check-specific diagnostic shape (YCK_* family). Extends the base Diagnostic with fields specific to check categories C1, C4, C7, C13.

target.description: IDL target string (e.g. 'functions.user_service') that failed validation (C1, C7).

resourceRef.description: IDL resource reference string (e.g. 'functions.external_svc') from resources.yaml (C4).

field.description: Field path within extension patch where the issue was found (C7).

file.description: File path where the referenced contract lives (C4).

availableIdls.description: Available IDLs in the generated model when target was missing (C1). Sorted alphabetically.

errorCodes.title: YCK_* error code catalog
errorCodes.description: Check-specific diagnostics of @ycforge/pilot ycsf check (spec 020 Key Entities). Compared via constants in src/check/errors.ts, never string literals (Constitution V). Codes are additive and non-breaking.

YCK_MISSING_TARGET.description: Extension target IDL does not exist in the generated model (C1, FR-008). Contains 'target' and 'availableIdls' fields.

YCK_ENV_IN_PATCH.description: Extension patch contains {{$ENV}} reference (C7, FR-011). Extensions use Terraform expressions, not build env. Contains 'target' and 'field' (recursive path).

YCK_REF_UNRESOLVED.description: Resource reference from resources.yaml has no matching generated Terraform resource (C4, FR-014). Contains 'resourceRef' and 'file'.

YCK_TERRAFORM_INVALID.description: terraform validate reported errors (C13, FR-017). Contains 'message' with terraform error output.

YCK_TERRAFORM_UNAVAILABLE.description: terraform binary not found in PATH (C13, FR-019). Base checks continue normally.

exitCodes.title: Exit code semantics (D-3)
exitCodes.description: Binary pass/fail exit codes for ycsf check CLI.

0.description: Clean — CheckResult.diagnostics is empty. All checks passed.

1.description: Error — CheckResult.diagnostics is non-empty. At least one check failed.

validateTf.description: Enable terraform validate final step. Requires terraform init.
